text:
GENERATE BURST T2P-walk-SE — Run C-9 pipeline test T2 (Matt R-C9-62): PAINT-OVER of the 3D manticore, walk facing SE, on one sheet. task_id "T2P-walk-SE".

IMAGE 1 is a SPRITE SHEET: 12 animation frames of ONE WALK CYCLE (a slow four-beat hound walk) of a four-legged creature facing the viewer's LOWER RIGHT (south-east), three-quarter view, in reading order (left to right, top to bottom), each frame centred in its own cell of a 4x3 grid on flat pure #00ff00. The frames are renders of a 3D model: their POSES, OUTLINES, POSITIONS and SIZES are correct, but their surface is flat and plastic.
IMAGE 2 is the APPROVED character sheet of this creature, the MANTICORE (four views: top-left front, top-right its right side facing the viewer's right, bottom-left back, bottom-right its left side facing the viewer's left): its lean hound body with ribs showing, blue-grey hide with a darker spine and paler belly, clawed paws, the long whip tail, and the calm bearded, long-haired face of a MAN with a mane around it; and the painter's hand (dark ink line, hatching, transparent washes). IMAGE 3 is the 13th-century bestiary page it comes from: the face and the uncanny calm to keep.
Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 and deliver ONE 1536x1024 sheet in which EVERY figure is repainted as the manticore of IMAGE 2, in EXACTLY that frame's pose, outline, position and size: same place in its cell, same leg, tail and head angles, paws on the same spots. Paint every frame as ONE consistent creature in ONE consistent hand: the same hide, markings, mane, face and colours in every frame (this is an animation: any change between frames will flicker). The face stays the calm bearded man's face of IMAGE 2 and IMAGE 3 in every frame.
Keep the background flat pure #00ff00 and the 4x3 grid exactly as laid out: no frame added, removed, merged or reordered, no cell borders, no text, no ground shadows.
STYLE: the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY IMAGE 2: copy its hand; do not restyle.

Two image_gen EDIT calls: variants a and b. ONE retry per variant only if a frame's pose, facing or position changed, a frame is missing or duplicated, the creature differs between frames, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy outputs to out/T2P-walk-SE_a.png and out/T2P-walk-SE_b.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "T2P-walk-SE"; images = the files with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — the sheet to EDIT (12 walk frames of the Meshy 3D manticore; poses correct, surface flat)
IMAGE 2 — the approved four-view character sheet of the manticore (look, markings, face, hand)
IMAGE 3 — the bestiary source (Rochester Bestiary, c.1230, public domain): the face and its calm
